evals.prompt: Build a CSV export feature for the reports page. It touches the API, the UI and a new background job.
evals.expected_output: Drives phases 0 to 6: constitution check, specify (docs/specs/<date>-<slug>/spec.md), clarify, plan, tasks, implement, converge; ends with the mandatory reconciliation block.
assertions: Runs phases in order: constitution, specify, clarify, plan, tasks, implement, converge
Spec is written under docs/specs/<date>-<slug>/spec.md, not .specify/
Wide implementation (5 or more files or 2 or more modules) triggers one adversarial critic pass (T2) logged to autonomy-gates.jsonl
Merge or deploy in phase 6 is T3 and asks the human
Ends with the SPEC-DRIVEN DEVELOP reconciliation block with per-phase status and Verification and Next lines

evals.prompt: Implement dark mode toggle across the app, 12 components.
evals.expected_output: Any phase with no work is marked SKIPPED with the unmet precondition, never omitted; analysis phases use write-incapable agent types.
assertions: A phase with nothing to do is marked SKIPPED (precondition not met), not omitted
Analysis phases (0, 2, 6) are dispatched with write-incapable agent types
Does not substitute /debate for the phase 6 critic pass
Reconciliation block printed even if a phase bails

evals.prompt: Fix the typo 'recieve' in the README.
evals.expected_output: Trivial mechanical edit (under 3 files): skip the pipeline, go straight to a direct edit.
assertions: Does not create a spec or plan
Does not print a reconciliation block
